name: multi-agent-workspace
description: Multi-Agent AI Workspace — local-first Windows dev

scripts.dev:concurrent: concurrently "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && npm --prefix frontend install
